featured.description: Warm, cute everyday-life risograph posters: one chunky rounded person does an ordinary daily action while exactly one object is absurdly oversized, printed in three inks (warm orange, olive green, near-black) on cream paper with misregistration, ink grain, coarse halftone and overprint brown, plus one tiny corner label.

styles.summary: Analog editorial photography with local square pixel displacement, restless ivory cut-out lettering and a fine woven print grid across vinyl, motion, citrus and architecture.
Near-black photographic forms on cool white silence, one ember-orange translucent signal and stretched optical afterimages, set in restrained futuristic editorial type.
Three-ink risograph posters of one chunky rounded person doing a daily routine with exactly one absurdly oversized object, misregistration, halftone grain and a tiny corner label.
Part 2: moving day, morning coffee, an ice-cream treat and a bakery bike ride in three-ink orange, olive and black riso with one oversized object.
Part 3: a bearded grandfather's mornings — a giant dumbbell, a wall-sized newspaper, a towering tea steam and a tortoise friend — in three-ink orange, olive and black riso.
Part 4: the grandfather's afternoons — a giant pumpkin, an oversized xiangqi piece, an endless nap blanket and a huge fresh catch — in three-ink orange, olive and black riso.
Exaggerated geometric character posters with sculptural color blocks, minimal black faces, hot-pink clashes, airbrushed shadows and fine print grain.
Part 2: bread baking, cycling, dog walking and photography in exaggerated geometric figures, hot-pink clashes and grainy print texture.
Part 3: topiary gardening, freediving, a chess move and carrying boxes in exaggerated geometric figures and hot-pink clashes.
Part 4: pottery throwing, kite flying, accordion playing and a stretching cat in large geometric bodies and hot-pink clashes.
Part 5: tea pouring, threading a needle, bowling and a snail in exaggerated geometry, hot-pink clashes and grainy print texture.
Part 6: roller painting, turning a key, tightrope balancing and a toucan in geometric exaggeration and hot-pink clashes.
Part 7: paper folding, headphone listening, canoe paddling and a sideways crab in geometric exaggeration and hot-pink clashes.
Extreme-perspective sports photos woven through giant white oblique type, with a bright color haze in a dark field.
Part 2: basketball, snowboarding, kayaking and boxing in giant white oblique type and single-color haze.
Part 3: tennis, still rings, speed skating and archery, framed as net, ring, blade and bowstring force structures.
Part 4: baseball swing, barbell lift, barrel surfing and gymnastics ribbon in giant white oblique type.
Punchy portrait posters mixing warm low-fi close-ups, blunt photo fragments, massive lemon-yellow lettering, and loose marker signals.
Warm amber macros with ivory serif type and fine orbital lines, turning tactile details into quiet editorial stories.
Intimate sports photographs with moody warm light, selective focus, and a white original logo plus two-line wordmark at center.
A second Felt Motion set: intimate sports photographs, selective focus, and a centered white logo with a tight two-line wordmark.
Giant condensed white lettering colliding with tactile botanical, musical, food, and chrome-product photography.
Athletic photography colliding with monumental condensed white type on warm stone neutrals and deep black shapes.
Experimental editorial posters with oversized condensed headlines, scarlet blocks, and photograph subjects cut by vertical slices.
High-contrast athletic posters colliding grayscale body photography, extreme perspective, and a single red-orange energy accent.
Sunlit editorial posters shaped by monumental condensed cream lettering, elastic curves, and subject/type depth exchanges.
Motion-led footwear campaigns showing a shoe mechanism through action, sequential states, and tactile engineering close-ups.
Minimal future-sport concepts pairing tactile podded outsoles with quiet athletic gestures, ice-cool architecture, and signal-coral accents.
Full-bleed future-sport posters isolating one razor-sharp piece of gear against directional motion trails and a giant white slogan.
Premium footwear process boards explaining load, flex, fit, and construction through sequential panels and tactile macros.
Photographic subjects dissolve into white paper, kept as hand-traced contours, intimate word labels, and sparse gray fragments.
Figures whose bodies are built from irregular black handwriting on pale paper, with compact heavy titles and sparse red marks.
Halftone portraits tiled by a white grid, with cells swapped for faded snapshots, blanks, and one fluorescent-pink memory.
Monumental single-color landscapes made from human fragments, inhabited by tiny figures.
Wide-angle action posters with an enlarged near-lens object, saturated blue environmental depth, an acid-colored angular burst, and oversized lean type sweeping through the foreground.
Close wide-angle action photography interlocked with enormous warm-cream condensed type, cobalt depth, and a compact rule-divided editorial rail.
Oversized grotesk type and emphatic event numerals over a grainy action photograph selectively re-inked through hard-edged stepped color windows.
High-contrast collages where monumental coarse halftones meet crisp color fragments, heavy display typography, and sparse handwritten marks.
Product-led oblique photography on muted grey, with precise highlighter editorial typography and a distinct composition for every product.
Playing-card editorial language with optical black ink ribbons, monumental high-contrast serif type, and a crisp colored figure on textured light paper.
Worm-eye airborne sports photography against open cool blue sky, with monumental ultra-condensed fluorescent type occluded by a foreshortened silhouette.
Playful hand-drawn megatype posters with irregular interlocking colored letters, bold black marker contours, sparse doodles, and neutral paper.
Tactile event posters with repeated photocopied flyers spilling from a saturated paper envelope, framed by cutout icons and spare black type.
Severe black-and-white editorial posters with an oversized compressed headline, a dense technical micro-information grid, and one monumentally cropped documentary photograph.
Close wide-angle portraits wrapped by a descending sculptural 3D type helix, with strong near/far letter scale, unobstructed faces, and case-specific materials and palettes.
High-energy motorsport editorial posters with dramatic racing photography, oversized condensed type, industrial info cards, and signal-yellow technical accents.
High-contrast editorial collage with cream-and-vermilion split fields, monumental cropped black letter architecture, monochrome full-body subjects, and tactile screenprint texture.
Monochrome ultra-wide forced-perspective corridors with a lone silhouette walker, giant scarlet geometric letter planes receding toward the vanishing point, and motion-blurred crowds.
Retro-pop scrapbook posters with oversized yellow headline typography, scarlet offset shadows, thick white die-cut photo cutouts, textured cobalt-blue paper, and playful accent stickers.
Confrontational editorial posters with monumental condensed type, red-and-black duotone photography, rigid off-white gutters, and paper-like ink grain treated as equal grid modules.
High-contrast editorial campaign posters with a dark ember-lit cropped hero, an oversized foreground prop that breaks the dark-versus-paper seam, and a quiet warm-paper type field.
Confrontational editorial posters with monumental ultra-condensed red type, a cropped black-and-white halftone portrait, offset photo fragments, and electric-blue and acid-green marker scribbles.
Hand-pulled theatrical screenprint posters with a monumental front-facing character, a limited vermilion-to-rose ink family, carved folk-pattern fills, and integrated hand-lettered type.
Crisp editorial posters built from a diagonal cluster of oversized rounded cuboids in oblique isometric depth, with primary-color top planes, oversized grotesk labels, and Swiss-style perimeter copy.
Severe two-ink public-information posters with a near-black field, a monumental flat silhouette traced by an agitated signal-red contour, and detached white grotesk text fragments.
High-impact pop ad posters placing an oversized photoreal cutout over monumental warped display lettering, on an electric-yellow field with black-and-cobalt type and severe cropping.
Dense celebratory editorial posters with a flash-lit photographic hero cutout, burnt-orange screenprint panels, monumental condensed headlines, coarse halftone diagrams, and dry-brush lettering.
Maximal indie-magazine covers with a fragmented signal-red masthead, a monumental flat-color side-profile portrait, and a right-heavy mantle of overlapping cobalt, coral, and pink petal lobes.
High-saturation editorial posters pairing a low-angle photographic cutout with oversized irregular orange lettering, a cobalt-to-sky-blue field, and flat green organic shapes.
Prestige culture-magazine covers with a monumental grayscale portrait, narrow Didone display type, selective deep-crimson fragments, and a fibrous newsprint finish.
High-energy event posters with a full-bleed motion-smeared photo, a cobalt field, fluorescent-green ultra-condensed type, oversized lower-edge numerals, and analog print texture.
Sparse fashion-editorial posters with a warm paper field, a centered halftone portrait, monumental cobalt Didone type, and an irregular torn-paper reveal.
Kinetic worm's-eye ad posters with a monumental foreground product, a receding figure, giant edge-cropped diagonal neo-grotesk type, and a dark-to-luminous gradient field.

Confrontational posters built from one monumentally cropped near-binary photocopy photograph, a vertical condensed headline rail, compact annotations, and a single vermilion ink layer of sharp shards and edge-born organic forms.

Compressed cobalt posters where fragmented grotesk headlines, two enormous repeated outline-script words, an ambiguous macro halftone photo, a dark flat Xerox cutout, and dense microcopy collide edge to edge.

Tactile motion posters built from a coral-red paper field, one pale-blue photographic window, colossal black condensed type crossing the image boundary, a single action subject, sparse micro labels, and one bold direction symbol.

Nostalgic roadside-travel posters combining cropped cobalt megatype, sparse locator graphics, warm straight-on architectural photography, cream uncoated paper, and one loose hand-painted word across the dark foreground.

Dense neo-editorial posters layering monumental white typography behind a centered surreal photographic cutout, framed by technical microcopy, ruled panels, celestial symbols, and coarse vintage grain on black.
Surreal collage posters layering monumental flat-ink beasts and tiny figures over faded archival city photography, with cut-paper masses, hand-drawn contours, and sparse bright accents.
Sparse black posters built around one oversized translucent glass animal with smoky depth, liquid-chrome edges, rainbow refractions, and futuristic micro-editorial weekend copy.
Nostalgic scenic travel posters with enormous warm-ivory condensed headlines, a flowing tangerine script accent, tiny magazine microcopy, and sun-faded analog film grain.
Sparse experimental posters built from one radically enlarged macro photograph, a saturated cyan field, monumental interlocking white letterforms, and tactile analog print grain.
Retro-futurist editorial portrait posters with a technical dossier sidebar, an edge-cropped posterized face, liquid-chrome interruptions, optical diagrams, and coarse halftone print grain.
Anime motorsport dossier posters pairing an original rider with a hero motorcycle, oversized italic model codes, a cream-and-magenta editorial grid, and a compact spec card.
Photocopied editorial collage posters with a distressed black headline, a halftone photo cutout, cyan-green misregistration, fluorescent paint swashes, and marker scribbles.
High-density manga dossier posters with a foreshortened hero, distressed condensed headlines, newspaper sidebars, and a crimson-black-paper palette.
Studio action posters with an overhead subject, stacked dark-green megatype, a fluorescent-lime motion loop, and clean white space.
Fisheye street posters mixing manga ink cutouts, sprayed yellow graffiti type, pavement tag texture, and anxious character energy.
Fast-food billboard collages with red-and-yellow blocks, glossy cutout products, and a trophy silhouette built from product objects.
Manga dossier posters with cream margins, grayscale ink portraits, cobalt-blue technical panels, and editorial annotation rails.
Dense red-black manga tabloids with cropped ink characters, editorial metadata blocks, halftone shading, and photocopy paper texture.
Ice-white action posters with oversized cyan megatype, ghost text layers, a cutout action photo, and chartreuse motion blur.
Scarlet action key-art with diagonal block megatype, layered cutout subjects, hard graphic shadows, and controlled print grain.
High-impact street posters with black-and-white photo cores, jagged red-and-black display type, thick white gutters, and three-color print energy.
Hyper-saturated 3D stadium posters with toy-like heroes, cropped condensed type, lime-and-purple fields, and motion-blurred debris.
Full-bleed dusk photo posters with navy silhouettes, oversized cyan-and-white type, script swashes, and crisp vector icons.
Electric-blue manga posters with white cutout geometry, rounded modular type, orange microtype, and a cel-shaded subject in exaggerated perspective.
Dense Y2K street collages with cutout subjects, sticker props, comic typography, and saturated yellow-blue-green accents.
Manga ink city scenes with cream cloud masses, sparse teal frames, peach accents, and precise miniature urban architecture.
Raw red-and-yellow action-culture covers with flash-lit cutouts, warped headline type, boxed callouts, and analog print grit.
Black-and-white xerox sports dossiers with cropped subjects, inset photo panels, distressed condensed type, and press-kit grain.
High-impact clearance posters with glossy liquid-chrome 3D type, acid-lime gradients, sale-interface microcopy, and barcode-style retail panels.
Loud underground comic flyers with mustard fields, coral cutouts, heavy marker outlines, hand-lettered bubble type, and dense comic symbols.
High-energy action posters built from staggered photo tiles, a cutout motion subject, bold black condensed type, loose ink speed marks, and sparse line-art scaffolding.
Sunlit photoreal coastal product ads with tropical botanicals, ocean-blue depth, distressed white brush type, dense label blocks, curved callouts, and gold seal badges.
Black-and-white footwear tech-spec posters with an oversized sneaker hero, engineering grid, evidence panels, macro callouts, pixelated uppercase type, and coarse halftone print.
Sky-blue doodle posters with chunky white type, a hanging lucky-tag plaque, thick black outlines, and one big playful mascot.
Neon event posters with huge condensed type, documentary photo crops, and raw white scribble gestures.
Sparse riso posters with wavering contours, overprint accents, handwritten margins, and visible paper grain.
Cream grocer posters with jade glyphs, vegetable silhouettes, and glossy produce-photo centerpieces.
Scarlet action posters with blue sports panels, cutout athletes, cream typography, and gritty print texture.
Sunlit sports editorials with oversized cream block type, diagonal photo crops, and bright sky fields.
Literary white-paper covers with scarlet letterforms, central cutout objects, marker contours, and asymmetrical space.
Retro PSA posters where everyday materials form symbolic halftone silhouettes on aged paper.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 复古公益海报，用日常材料拼出象征性网点剪影，铺在老纸张上。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 復古公益海報，用日常材料拼出象徵性網點剪影，鋪在老紙張上。
summary_i18n.ja: 日用品で象徴的なハーフトーンシルエットを作る、古紙風のレトロPSAポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 일상 소재로 상징적 하프톤 실루엣을 만드는 낡은 종이 질감의 레트로 PSA 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster PSA retro dengan material sehari-hari yang membentuk siluet halftone simbolik di atas kertas tua.

styles.summary: Nostalgic grid-paper posters with torn-paper cutout objects, handwritten notes, and soft shadows.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 怀旧方格纸海报，撕纸剪贴物件、手写笔记和柔和纸影。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 懷舊方格紙海報，撕紙剪貼物件、手寫筆記和柔和紙影。
summary_i18n.ja: 方眼紙に切り貼りした紙のオブジェ、手書きメモ、柔らかな影を置く懐かしいポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 격자 종이에 찢은 종이 오브젝트, 손글씨 메모, 부드러운 그림자를 얹은 향수 어린 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster kertas grid bernuansa nostalgia dengan objek potongan kertas, catatan tangan, dan bayangan lembut.

styles.summary: Absurd quote-card posters with crude marker outlines, pastel panels, blue lettering, and object gags.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 荒诞语录卡海报，粗马克笔轮廓、粉彩面板、蓝色块字和物件笑点。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 荒誕語錄卡海報，粗麥克筆輪廓、粉彩面板、藍色塊字和物件笑點。
summary_i18n.ja: 粗いマーカー線、パステル面、青い角文字、物のギャグで作る不条理な引用カードポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 거친 마커 윤곽, 파스텔 패널, 파란 블록 글자, 사물 개그가 있는 부조리한 인용 카드 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster quote-card absurd dengan outline marker kasar, panel pastel, huruf biru, dan gag objek.

styles.summary: Sky-blue home-life posters with house insets, giant black lettering, badges, and marker doodle scenes.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 天蓝家居生活海报，房屋白框、巨大黑色手写字、徽章和马克笔场景。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 天藍居家生活海報，房屋白框、巨大黑色手寫字、徽章和麥克筆場景。
summary_i18n.ja: 空色の家型フレーム、巨大な黒手描き文字、バッジ、マーカー日常シーンのホームポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 하늘색 집 모양 인셋, 거대한 검은 손글씨, 배지, 마커 일상 장면의 홈 라이프 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster home-life biru langit dengan inset rumah, lettering hitam besar, badge, dan adegan doodle marker.

styles.summary: Playful grounding posters with cream margins, marker blocks, uneven keylines, big lettering, and mascot figures.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 轻快 grounding 海报，米色边距、马克笔色块、粗描边、大字和吉祥物人物。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 輕快 grounding 海報，米色邊距、麥克筆色塊、粗描邊、大字和吉祥物人物。
summary_i18n.ja: クリーム余白、マーカー色面、太い不均一線、大きな文字、マスコット人物の軽快な啓発ポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 크림 여백, 마커 색면, 굵은 불균형 선, 큰 글자, 마스코트 인물이 있는 경쾌한 그라운딩 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster grounding playful dengan margin krem, blok marker, keyline kasar, huruf besar, dan figur maskot.

styles.summary: Naive monster posters with thick marker outlines, crayon fills, cream paper, and chunky handmade type.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 童趣怪物海报，粗马克笔轮廓、蜡笔色块、米色纸纹和手写粗字。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 童趣怪物海報，粗麥克筆輪廓、蠟筆色塊、米色紙紋和手寫粗字。
summary_i18n.ja: 太いマーカー線、クレヨン塗り、クリーム紙、手描き文字の素朴なモンスターポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 굵은 마커 윤곽, 크레용 채색, 크림 종이, 손글씨 타입의 순진한 몬스터 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster monster naif dengan outline marker tebal, warna krayon, kertas krem, dan huruf handmade.

styles.summary: Cyan-red impact posters with giant block type, jagged shockwaves, yellow accents, and rotated microcopy.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 青红冲击海报，巨大块状字、锯齿冲击波、柠檬黄人物点缀和旋转微文案。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 青紅衝擊海報，巨大塊狀字、鋸齒衝擊波、檸檬黃人物點綴和旋轉微文案。
summary_i18n.ja: 巨大な赤いブロック文字、ギザギザ衝撃波、黄色アクセント、回転小文字のシアン系インパクトポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 거대한 빨간 블록 타입, 들쭉날쭉한 쇼크웨이브, 노란 포인트, 회전 마이크로카피의 시안 임팩트 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster impact sian-merah dengan tipe blok raksasa, shockwave bergerigi, aksen kuning, dan microcopy miring.

styles.summary: Naive fantasy mascot posters with neon marker fills, huge wobbly type, and dense scribbles.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 幻想吉祥物手绘海报，荧光马克笔色块、摇晃大字和密集涂鸦。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 幻想吉祥物手繪海報，螢光麥克筆色塊、搖晃大字和密集塗鴉。
summary_i18n.ja: ネオンマーカーのマスコット、巨大な手描き文字、密な落書きで作る素朴な幻想ポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 네온 마커 마스코트, 커다란 손글씨, 빽빽한 낙서로 만든 순진한 판타지 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster maskot fantasi naif dengan warna marker neon, huruf goyah besar, dan coretan padat.

styles.summary: Sparse crayon catalog posters with red handmade headlines, simple doodles, and folded paper texture.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 蜡笔目录海报，红色手写标题、简单产品涂鸦和折纸质感。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 蠟筆目錄海報，紅色手寫標題、簡單產品塗鴉和摺紙質感。
summary_i18n.ja: 赤い手描き見出し、シンプルな落書き、折り紙質感で作る余白の多いクレヨン目録ポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 빨간 손글씨 헤드라인, 단순한 낙서, 접힌 종이 질감의 성긴 크레용 카탈로그 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster katalog krayon yang lapang dengan headline merah handmade, doodle sederhana, dan tekstur kertas lipat.

styles.summary: Cobalt ransom-zine posters with torn scraps, halftone cutouts, and marker lettering.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 钴蓝 ransom zine 海报，撕纸块、半调切图和马克笔字。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 鈷藍 ransom zine 海報，撕紙塊、半調切圖和麥克筆字。
summary_i18n.ja: 破れ紙、ハーフトーン切り抜き、マーカー文字で作るコバルトブルーのransom zineポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 찢어진 종이 조각, 하프톤 컷아웃, 마커 글자를 결합한 코발트 블루 랜섬 진 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster ransom-zine biru kobalt dengan sobekan kertas, cutout halftone, dan lettering marker.

styles.summary: Farmers-market produce posters with giant glossy crops, rough brush type, and ivory paper space.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 菜市场蔬果海报，超大光泽作物、粗刷字体和象牙色纸面留白。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 菜市場蔬果海報，超大光澤作物、粗刷字體和象牙色紙面留白。
summary_i18n.ja: 巨大な光沢ある青果、荒い筆文字、アイボリーの余白を使う市場ポスター。
summary_i18n.ko: 거대한 광택 농산물, 거친 붓글씨, 아이보리 종이 여백의 시장 포스터.
summary_i18n.id: Poster pasar hasil bumi dengan tanaman glossy raksasa, huruf kuas kasar, dan ruang kertas ivory.

styles.summary: Folded newspaper advertorials with oversized product cutouts, dense columns, stamps, and antique-gold type.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 折叠报纸广告视觉，超大产品切图、密集分栏、印章和古金色标题。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 折疊報紙廣告視覺，超大產品切圖、密集分欄、印章和古金色標題。
summary_i18n.ja: 折りたたみ新聞広告風。巨大な商品切り抜き、密なカラム、スタンプ、古金色の見出し。
summary_i18n.ko: 접힌 신문 애드버토리얼, 거대한 제품 컷아웃, 촘촘한 칼럼, 스탬프, 앤티크 골드 타이프.
summary_i18n.id: Advertorial koran lipat dengan cutout produk besar, kolom padat, stempel, dan judul antique-gold.

styles.summary: Sunlit supermodel editorials with outdoor texture, nameplate details, and clean lower-third type.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 日光超模编辑视觉，户外质感、名牌细节和干净下三分之一排版。
summary_i18n.zh-TW: 日光超模編輯視覺，戶外質感、名牌細節和乾淨下三分之一排版。
summary_i18n.ja: 日差しのあるスーパーモデル編集ビジュアル、屋外質感、ネームプレート、整った下三分の一組版。
summary_i18n.ko: 햇빛 슈퍼모델 에디토리얼, 야외 질감, 네임플레이트, 정돈된 하단 타이포.
